products.name: Noor Kundan Jhumka Earrings
products.alt: Pair of gold-tone jhumka earrings with filigree domes (demo photo)
products.short: Bell-shaped gold-tone jhumkas set with white kundan stones and a fringe of faux pearls.
products.description:
Our Noor jhumkas pair a floral kundan stud with a domed bell finished in fine gold-tone plating and edged with faux pearls. Lightweight enough for a full evening, they suit mehndi, Eid and wedding looks.

Material: brass alloy with gold-tone plating, kundan glass stones, faux pearls.
Length: approx. 5.5 cm. Push-back closure.
Care: keep dry, avoid perfume, store in the Ayatcollections pouch.

products.name: Zara Floral Drop Earrings
products.alt: Rose-gold floral drop earrings on white fabric (demo photo)
products.short: Delicate rose-gold flower drops on fine hooks — light enough for every day.
products.description:
Zara drops are shaped like an opening bloom in a warm rose-gold tone, hung on slim hook fittings. Pretty with western and eastern outfits alike.

Material: alloy with rose-gold-tone plating.
Length: approx. 3 cm. Hook closure.
Care: wipe with a soft dry cloth after wearing.

products.name: Rania Gold Bead Necklace
products.alt: Gold-tone beaded temple necklace with coloured stones (demo photo)
products.short: A rich gold-tone bead necklace with coloured stone accents, made for festive wear.
products.description:
Rania layers rows of gold-tone beads and petals with coloured stone accents for a classic festive look. Wear it with a matching pair of jhumkas for mehndi or Eid.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, glass stones.
Fit: adjustable dori, 36–44 cm.
Care: store flat in its box; avoid water and perfume.

products.name: Mehr Teardrop Pendant
products.alt: Gold-tone teardrop pendant on a fine chain (demo photo)
products.short: A teardrop pendant with a soft gold finish on a fine chain.
products.description:
Mehr is a simple teardrop pendant in a polished gold tone on a fine cable chain — an easy everyday piece and a lovely gift.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Length: 45 cm with 5 cm extender. Lobster clasp.
Care: fasten the clasp before storing.

products.name: Laila Gold Bangle Set
products.alt: Four polished gold-tone bangles stacked together (demo photo)
products.short: Four polished gold-tone bangles, sold as a set. Choose your bangle size.
products.description:
The Laila set is four engraved karas with a soft, hand-polished shine. Wear all four together or split them across both wrists.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating.
Sizes: 2.4 (small), 2.6 (medium), 2.8 (large) — the inner diameter in inches.
Care: remove before washing hands; store in the pouch.

products.name: Sana Crystal Cuff Bangle
products.alt: Gold-tone open cuff bangle set with clear crystals (demo photo)
products.short: An open gold-tone cuff lined with sparkling crystals.
products.description:
Sana is a slim open cuff with a row of clear crystals that catch the light. It slips on easily and pairs well with a watch or other bangles.

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia.
Fit: adjustable, fits most wrists.
Care: clean gently with a soft dry cloth.

products.name: Hira Pink Halo Ring
products.alt: Rose-gold ring with a pink stone in a crystal halo (demo photo)
products.short: A pink cushion stone in a halo of crystals. Choose your ring size.
products.description:
Hira sets a cushion-cut pink stone in a bright halo of small crystals on a rose-gold-tone band — a sweet statement ring for engagements and parties.

Material: alloy with rose-gold-tone plating, glass stone, cubic zirconia.
Sizes: 6, 7, 8 (US).
Care: remove before applying lotion or perfume.

products.name: Amal Stackable Ring Trio
products.alt: Three slim gold-tone rings with small stones in a ring box (demo photo)
products.short: Three slim rings with tiny stones — wear them together or apart.
products.description:
Amal is a trio of slim stacking rings: a plain polished band, a pavé zircon band and a band set with a single purple stone. One size fits most (US 6–7).

Material: alloy with gold-tone plating, cubic zirconia, glass stone.
Care: store each ring separately to avoid scratches.
